name: hero
facts: The chain is seven documents written in order, from vision to plan (z2s/steps.py, DOCUMENTS)
The pipeline runs six gates over a document set: generation, validation, coverage, view, design and budgets (z2s/pipeline.py)
The plugin ships fifteen skills, one for each step of the chain and the operations around it (skills/, z2s/steps.py)
The published specification set holds 200 requirements and decisions, every one claimed by a unit of work (python3 -m z2s.trace docs/*.html)
The toolchain takes no third-party runtime dependency and uses the Python standard library only (NFR-ARC-03)
